lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly higher intensity intersect with the high-luminance spots, particularly visible in the mid-body section where the spots act as nodes within a vertical-horizontal grid matrix.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A clear horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a distinct intensity gradient transition from light on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin surface contains approximately 8-12 visible high-luminance spots of smaller diameter than those on the flank, distributed across the lower and middle regions of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct slender fish, likely remoras, are visible in the ventral water column below the pectoral fin and mid-body section.
